children: CBRE Global Real Estate Income Fund implemented a 1-for-3 reverse stock split and adjusted its monthly distribution to $0.18 per share.
Board approved 1-for-3 reverse split to boost per-share market price and potentially broaden investor base.
Reverse split effective after close on September 4, 2026; trading continues under ticker IGR with new CUSIP 12504G878.
Monthly distribution adjusted from $0.06 to $0.18 per share beginning with first post-split declaration; monthly cash flow unchanged.
No fractional shares issued; fractions will be aggregated, sold and proceeds distributed pro rata net of fees.
September 2026 distribution amended: declaration 08-31-2026, ex-record date 09-21-2026, payable 09-30-2026; estimated sources: 8% net investment income, 92% return of capital.
